blocks.text: English
`@migaia/log-host` 的控制台输出。在终端或 CI 里输出带颜色、保留原生对象和错误堆栈的可读格式；输出被重定向、交给日志采集时默认一行一条 JSON，不用为两种环境各写一套配置。

items: 线上日志没法检索：开发时好读的彩色文本进了日志系统，变成一堆转义字符和拆散的多行堆栈。根因是输出格式没有随运行环境切换。
对象被打成 `[object Object]`：日志库先把参数拼成字符串再交给控制台，丢掉了控制台本来能展开的对象和错误堆栈。根因是格式化发生在控制台之前。

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
[INFO] user alice signed in
[WARN] disk usage at 91%

blocks.text: `%s`、`%d` 这些占位符由控制台自己处理，参数原样交给 `console.log` / `console.warn` / `console.error`，所以对象可以展开、错误带完整堆栈。`warn` 走 `console.warn`，`error` 和 `fatal` 走 `console.error`，其他级别走 `console.log`。
不写 `features` 时格式自动选择：先看环境变量 `LOG_FORMAT=json|pretty`；没有设置时，在 CI 中或输出是终端则用可读格式，否则输出 JSON。要固定输出 JSON，在 `features` 里写 `format: formatFeature({ format: 'json' })`（`@migaia/log-host/features`）。

rows: `console` 默认全局 console，`stdout` 默认识别到的 `process.stdout`；都只借用，卸载时不关闭
可读格式。`color` 取 `auto`（默认）、`always`、`never`；`timestamp` 默认 `true`
安装后 host 多出的方法：把原始文本直接写到 stdout（例如进度条的 `\r`），没有 stdout 时用 `console.log`

blocks.text: `color: 'auto'` 依次看 `NO_COLOR`、非零的 `FORCE_COLOR`、是否终端、是否 CI。

items: 日志方法同步返回，交付异步进行；读取测试用的控制台或准备退出前，等待 `flush()` 或 `shutdown()`。
作为参数传入的 Error 只交给控制台一次；`data.silent` 为真的条目（例如 reasoning 插件的完整阶段记录）不在控制台重复输出。
`meta` 按 host 入口的浅复制规则交付：同一个对象同时作为参数和 `meta` 传入时，参数里的原对象和 `meta` 副本都会交给控制台。
写入失败（包括 `raw`）进入 host 的失败通道，处理器收到原始错误。读取选项失败时同步抛出 `logging.console / INVALID_OPTION`，原因在 `cause`。
`features` 的写法、host 级默认策略和覆盖规则与所有输出插件相同，见 log-host 的组合策略。

blocks.text: 公开导出：`consolePlugin`、`prettyFeature`、`ConsoleColorMode`、`LogConsoleErrorCode`。运行时第三方依赖只有 `ansis`。完整示例见 使用指南。
安装 `@migaia/log-plugin-console` 与相同版本的 `@migaia/log-host`。输出插件只依赖 host、utils 与 ansis，不要求安装其它输出插件。
`consolePlugin` 接受 `console`、`stdout`、`features`。console 是拥有 `log`、`warn`、`error` 方法的借用对象；调用保留该对象的 receiver。stdout 拥有 `write(text)`，可提供 `isTTY`。默认分别取全局 console 与识别到的宿主 process.stdout；卸载不关闭这些能力。

输出自己配置的 format 替换 host 级的 format，名称不同也一样；一个插件的 `features` 里最多一个 format。没有显式 format 时使用输出默认值：先读取 `LOG_FORMAT=json|pretty`；没有设置时，在 CI 中或 stdout 是终端则用 pretty，否则为 JSON。plain 需要显式 `formatFeature({ format: 'plain' })`。
pretty 保留占位符、原 args 顺序、对象和 Error 身份；为时间、tag、上下文等添加前缀。其它 formatter 的结果作为一个 text 参数交付。`warn` 走 warn，`error`/`fatal` 走 error，其余走 log；silent 条目不输出。
`prettyFeature({ color, timestamp })` 的 color 默认为 auto，可用 `ConsoleColorMode.auto`、`always`、`never`。always/never 优先；auto 依次考虑 NO_COLOR、非零 FORCE_COLOR、TTY、CI。timestamp 默认为 true。
日志方法同步返回，交付异步执行；读取测试控制台或准备退出前应等待 flush/shutdown。raw 同步使用 stdout.write，缺少 stdout 时用 console.log；原始能力错误进入 host 的 onFailure，处理器收到原错误。读取选项失败时同步抛出 `logging.console / INVALID_OPTION`，原因在 `cause`。
meta 保留 host 入口的浅复制语义；同一对象同时作为 args 与 meta 传入时，原 args 对象与额外 meta 副本都会交给控制台。
`features` 写成 `{ 名称: feature }` 记录；Feature 的控制方法以 `console_<名称>_<方法>` 挂在 host 上，例如名称为 `threshold` 时是 `console_threshold_setLevel`。host 级默认策略和覆盖规则见 log-host 的组合策略。
中文

Console output for `@migaia/log-host`. On a terminal or in CI it prints a readable, colored format that keeps native objects and error stacks; when output is redirected or collected by a log pipeline it prints one JSON object per line by default, so you do not need separate setups for the two environments.

items: Production logs cannot be searched: colored text that reads well in development reaches the log system as escape codes and stack traces split across lines. The cause is that the output format does not follow the environment.

Objects print as `[object Object]`: the logger joins arguments into a string before the console sees them, losing the object expansion and error stacks the console could show. The cause is formatting before the console.

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
[INFO] user alice signed in
[WARN] disk usage at 91%

blocks.text: Placeholders such as `%s` and `%d` are handled by the console itself. Arguments reach `console.log` / `console.warn` / `console.error` unchanged, so objects expand and errors keep their full stack. `warn` goes to `console.warn`, `error` and `fatal` go to `console.error`, and other levels go to `console.log`.

Without `features`, the format is chosen automatically: first the `LOG_FORMAT=json|pretty` environment variable; when it is not set, the readable format is used in CI or when output is a terminal, and JSON otherwise. To always print JSON, put `format: formatFeature({ format: 'json' })` (from `@migaia/log-host/features`) in `features`.

rows: `console` defaults to the global console and `stdout` to the detected `process.stdout`; both are borrowed and not closed on removal
Readable format. `color` is `auto` (default), `always` or `never`; `timestamp` defaults to `true`
Added to the host on install: writes raw text straight to stdout (for example a progress bar's `\r`), or to `console.log` without stdout

blocks.text: `color: 'auto'` checks, in order, `NO_COLOR`, a non-zero `FORCE_COLOR`, whether the output is a terminal, and whether it runs in CI.

items: Log methods return synchronously and delivery is asynchronous; await `flush()` or `shutdown()` before reading a test console or exiting.
An Error passed as an argument reaches the console once. Entries with a truthy `data.silent` (for example the reasoning plugin's completed-phase records) are not printed again.
`meta` follows the host's shallow-copy rule: when one object is passed both as an argument and as `meta`, the console receives the original argument and the `meta` copy.

Write failures (including `raw`) go to the host's failure channel, and handlers receive the original error. An option that cannot be read throws `logging.console / INVALID_OPTION` synchronously, with the reason in `cause`.
How to write `features`, host-wide defaults and override rules are the same for every output plugin; see Composing policies in log-host.

blocks.text: Public exports: `consolePlugin`, `prettyFeature`, `ConsoleColorMode` and `LogConsoleErrorCode`. The only third-party runtime dependency is `ansis`. See the usage guide for full examples.
Install `@migaia/log-plugin-console` with the same version of `@migaia/log-host`. Its runtime dependencies are host, utils, and ansis; other output plugins are optional.

`consolePlugin` accepts `console`, `stdout`, and `features`. The borrowed console implements log/warn/error and retains its receiver. The borrowed stdout implements write(text) and optionally isTTY. Defaults are the global console and recognized host process.stdout. Removing the plugin does not close either capability.

A format configured on the output replaces the host-wide format, even under a different name; one plugin's `features` hold at most one format. Without an explicit format the output default applies: it reads LOG_FORMAT=json|pretty first; when that is not set it selects pretty in CI or when stdout is a terminal, and JSON otherwise. Select plain explicitly with `formatFeature({ format: 'plain' })`.

Pretty output retains placeholders, native argument order, objects, and Error identity while adding time/tag/context prefixes. Other formatters deliver their result as one text argument. Warn routes to warn; error/fatal route to error; other tags route to log. Silent entries produce no console output.

`prettyFeature({ color, timestamp })` defaults to color auto and timestamp true. `ConsoleColorMode` supplies auto/always/never. Explicit always/never win; auto considers NO_COLOR, nonzero FORCE_COLOR, TTY, then CI.

Log methods return synchronously and deliver asynchronously. Await flush/shutdown before inspecting a captured console or exiting. Raw writes synchronously to stdout.write, falling back to console.log. Capability failures reach host onFailure with the original error. An option that cannot be read throws `logging.console / INVALID_OPTION` synchronously, with the reason in `cause`.
Meta retains the host entry’s shallow-copy boundary. Passing the same object in args and as meta delivers both the original argument and an additional meta copy to the console.

`features` is a `{ name: feature }` record; a Feature's controls appear on the host as `console_<name>_<method>`, for example `console_threshold_setLevel` for the name `threshold`. For host-wide defaults and override rules see Composing policies in log-host.
